## Motivation / 动机

What problem does this solve?

这个功能解决什么问题？

## Proposed Solution / 期望方案

Describe the desired behavior.

请描述你期望的行为。

## Alternatives / 替代方案

What alternatives have you considered?

你考虑过哪些替代方案？

## CLI Design / CLI 设计

Show proposed commands and flags if applicable.

如涉及命令行，请给出命令和参数示例。

## Compatibility / 兼容性影响

Could this break existing workflows?

这是否会影响现有工作流？

## Willing to Submit PR / 是否愿意提交 PR

- [ ] Yes / 是
- [ ] No / 否
